description: This file defines the 'ModelTree' class for representing and rendering a tree structure based on XML configuration in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for nodes, labels, links, images, sub-nodes, and actions, and focuses on modeling tree elements, their conditions, rendering, and associated actions.

classes.name: ModelTree
classes.description: Represents a read-only tree structure modeled from XML, providing rendering and node management.

classes.name: ModelNode
classes.description: Represents a node within the tree, including labels, links, actions, and conditions, as well as rendering logic.

classes.name: ModelSubNode
classes.description: Represents a sub-node in the tree, with its own node name, actions, and associated node.

classes.name: ModelNode.Label
classes.description: Models a label element within a node, supporting dynamic text and styling.

classes.name: ModelNode.Link
classes.description: Models a hyperlink element within a node, supporting parameters, styling, security, and rendering.

classes.name: ModelNode.Image
classes.description: Models an image element with configurable dimensions, source, and style, used within nodes.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor as part of the visitor pattern.

methods.name: getDefaultEntityName
methods.description: Returns the default entity name for the tree.

methods.name: getExpandCollapseRequest
methods.description: Generates the expand/collapse request string based on context.

methods.name: renderTreeString
methods.description: Renders the tree structure into a string, beginning from the root node.

methods.name: getSendAsBinary
methods.description: Returns false indicating the output is not sent as binary.
